newsitem.title: USA: Alteon says diabetes therapy trial positive.
newsitem.headline: Alteon says diabetes therapy trial positive.

text.p: Alteon Inc said a Phase II trial of its lead compound, pimagedine, yielded positive results that support the compound's use as a potential therapy for diabetic complications.
Alteon said the trial showed pimagedine lowered key serum lipid levels in Type II diabetics with dyslipidemia (abnormal lipid profiles).
The company said additional analysis revealed that pimagedine also lowered albumin, a protein in the urine, by an average of 40 percent in patients identified as having albuminuria (protein leakage).
Alteon said it expects further Phase II data from its end-stage renal disease trial during the summer of 1997. A Phase III ACTION I trial in overt nephropathy is slated for 1998.
